evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Keyframe images; Approval / flag annotations. Approved keyframes are reused; flagged keyframes are regenerated and the shots concatenated.

Flagged keyframes are regenerated while approved ones are kept (mutation by a fixed review rule). For Co-Director, this specifically supports LLM-mediated memory editing of Approved-keyframe sequence.

During operation, Co-Director applies evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence to Approved-keyframe sequence; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 5): During inference, the operative memory component (Approved-keyframe sequence) changes through LLM-mediated memory editing, evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
